title: What should I expect in my first visit to Pinnacle for occupational therapy?
metaTitle: First Visit Expectations for Therapy Sessions | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Find out what to anticipate during your first visit to Pinnacle Blooms Network, where we conduct a comprehensive initial evaluation to create a unique therapy plan for your child's growth.
html: Welcome to Pinnacle Blooms. In your child's first visit, we conduct a comprehensive initial evaluation. Our expert therapists will spend time understanding your child's medical history, abilities, needs, and your concerns as a parent. This assessment will provide the foundation for your child's unique therapy plan that aims to unlock their full potential.
